integrity: Circular median transport is cited as earlier literature. The all-size proof is analytic; the accompanying finite verifier corroborates selected instances and exact Taylor orders only. Self-review has passed; independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: The theorem covers the unit-edge cycle \(C_n\) for every integer n at least seven, combinatorial continuous-time heat flow, real graph-Lipschitz seminorm and graph-distance Wasserstein-1. There are no assertions about weighted cycles, irregular normalized generators, higher transport exponents, or simultaneous large-n/large-t limits.
title: Quarter-cycle delay and exact heat-Lipschitz decay on finite cycles
